notes.title: Alter Evo — Announcement Trailer & Release Date
notes.notes:
Watch the Announcement Trailer [previewyoutube="QeUAVHgsTmY;full"][/previewyoutube]
Our trailer took 14 days of hard work to create, and we’re thrilled with how it turned out. We feel it captures the tone and aesthetic of Alter Evo better than anything we’ve released so far.


What's next?
We now enter three months of focused marketing and QA ahead of our December 1st launch. We can’t wait for you to experience Alter Evo in its entirety.

notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes / Adjustments 2/16/2025
notes.notes:
New fixes:

-Fixed soft lock bug where aiming during walk mode made you stuck in first person.

-Adjusted Gun Recoil.

-Fixed bug where your car floated very high in the air above TLAB.

-Add improved hand pose to pistol.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43552839/9cc642e2d1ab434207325a8b054fee06fb0573d8.png



What to expect in the next update?

-Improved enemy behavior

-Improved auto-aim and passive aim logic

Thanks for your continued support - we will be adding combat related features to build for the foreseeable future - so please let us know if you have any feedback or cool ideas of how to make it better here.

-Technical Fiction

notes.title: Combat Update Live Now
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43552839/4086cee729c680829e794bde4c3d43cc67812ae5.gif

Newly Added Features:

🔫 Gun Combat Enhancements:
Added automatic and manual aiming modes

🛣️ New Gameplay Elements:
More speed tunnels
Directional arrows when driving for better navigation

📖 Story and Scenes:
Additional backstory elements
New intro scene featuring combat sequences
Additional memos to enhance the lore

🌍 World Improvements:
Terrain fixes for smoother exploration
Vehicle changes, including enhanced hovering mechanics
Lighting updates in the apartment for better atmosphere

Coming Soon (In Development):

🔄 Reloading mechanics
🧰 Ammo pickups and health pickups
💥 Gun damage falloff over distance
🎥 Camera recoil when manually aiming

Stay tuned for more updates, and thanks for your continued support! Please leave 🚀

If you have any thought on how game mechanics can be improved leave us feedback here.

-Technical Fiction

notes.title: Big Demo Update Coming February 13th
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Thank you to everyone who has checked out the Alter Evo demo so far! We've noticed that many players are dropping off within the first 10 minutes, so we're making some changes to improve retention.

We are officially adding Gun Combat to improve the fun and play-ability of enemy sections.

We are making game flow and narrative improvements across the board.

All of these changes will be released on February 13th.

We will leave the demo up in it's current form until then.

Thanks again for your support.

Technical Fiction
